# WoW AndroWhere 0.8.8

- **Keyboard on a button (3.3.5a).** With Controller Menus installed, hold Select for half a second to open the Android keyboard, and again to close it. It works on the login screen, the email code box, character names and in game, so you no longer need Back, then Keyboard. A quick press of Select still reaches the game as before. The login and character creation hints show it.

## Install

Download **WoW-AndroWhere.apk** below, or update from inside the app. It installs over 0.8.7 and keeps your settings, saved login, game files and addons.

If Android says the app "conflicts with an existing package", your current copy came from somewhere else, such as the upstream WoW Foreverywhere releases. Uninstall it first, then install this one. Your game files and addons stay on your storage.

New to the app? See the [README](https://github.com/danielnoam/WoWAndroWhere#getting-started) for setup.
